_doc: One object per task. question -> what the agent is asked; biz -> in|us; expect.sections -> the status each finding section must end in (answered|refused|ambiguous); expect.path -> graph|chat|refusal; verifiers -> names from harness/verifiers.py; params -> data the verifiers read; write -> allow the agent to write (default false, dry run). Tasks marked author=claude-sample are patterns, not graded tests.
